publishing_experiment.scope: Fixed Beijing slots, not randomized. Primary groups use actual cumulative views observed at ages 24–26h / 72–74h / 168–170h, not exact target-hour counts. Only receipt-bound authenticated own-creator counters enter primary groups. Legacy search samples/groups remain visible separately, excluded from primary groups. Missing stays unknown; no retrospective backfill. Not CTR, retention or causal uplift. Slot/time, layout, topic, source and duration remain confounders.
publishing_experiment.legacy_scope: Fixed Beijing slots 1/3 baseline, 2/4 treatment; not randomized. Search-index cumulative views at ages 24–36h / 72–84h / 168–180h; not CTR, impressions, retention or causal uplift. Missing is null. Fallbacks and full interviews excluded from primary clip groups; slot/time, layout, topic, source and duration remain confounders.
